releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.TRONOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to TRON -- high-throughput blockchain optimised for entertainment and gaming with 2,000+ TPS, minimal fees, and TRC-20/TRC-721 support. Stores OASIS holons, avatars, and tokens. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add TRON header query candidate and preserve anonymous rate-limit failure (beb4f87)
- Batch adjacent TRON header selections and retain unresolved live quota evidence (c581a9f)
- Bind TRON prepared fee recovery to original signed authority (2e8e3f8)
- Bound native storage correlations and document approved operation fee policy (2acf0a8)
- Carry admitted cancellation through TRON Sui and Cosmos SDK boundaries (f2af1d9)
- Classify malformed chain storage responses as terminal data failures (3bd4342)
- Document and verify TRON Energy limits do not cap total native fees (a22ccf7)

- feat(tron): wire explicit per-deposit token provider routes (6d87a97)
